headline: World Bank Urges Somalia to Implement Urgent Domestic Revenue Reforms
summary: The World Bank urged Somalia to enact domestic revenue reforms, noting that domestic revenue stood at an estimated 6.3% of GDP in 2025, significantly below regional peers amid declining external assistance.
why: Somalia relies on international aid and structural economic reforms to achieve fiscal self-sufficiency and macroeconomic stability.

impacts.name: Somalia
impacts.why: Adopting World Bank tax reforms is necessary to expand government fiscal space as foreign aid falls.
